ops.does: Open the notes file and read it line by line as bytes (ReadLn into RawByteString)
implicit: notes file is bytes, not text; a last line without newline is still read; CRLF ends are stripped by ReadLn
Length counts bytes (rule.md §4/§5), not characters
StrToIntDef gives 0 on any parse failure, so a bad id maps to key '0'
Trim strips chars <= #32 only

ops.does: Take bytes 5-24 of the line as the note and convert Big5 (CP950) to UTF-8
implicit: Copy on bytes may cut a double-byte character; the cut half becomes '?' (MS950 decoder REPLACE with '?')
Copy clamps out-of-range count, never throws
DefaultSystemCodePage := CP_UTF8 (LegacyEtl.pas:39) makes SetCodePage(Note, CP_UTF8, True) yield UTF-8 and string field values UTF-8; Java strings are Unicode, nothing to port (rule.md §6)

ops.does: Store TrimRight(note) in Notes under key IntToStr(id); later lines for the same id overwrite
implicit: TStringList.Values[k] := '' DELETES the entry k (also an earlier one for the same id), it does not store an empty string
TrimRight strips chars <= #32 only, after decoding

ops.does: Drop and create T_CUST_CLEAN (CUST_ID INTEGER, NAME TEXT, CITY TEXT, JOIN_DATE TEXT, NOTE TEXT)
implicit: output table name through Tables.out, including DDL; column types fixed by the DDL

ops.does: Read CUSTOMER ordered by CUST_ID; Name = Trim(NAME); City = UpperCase(Trim(CITY)); Id = CUST_ID
implicit: AsString of NULL is ''
AsInteger of NULL is 0
UpperCase is ASCII only
Trim strips chars <= #32 only
ORDER BY CUST_ID

ops.does: JOIN_DATE as float; 0 (or NULL) gives '' else yyyymmdd text
implicit: AsFloat of NULL is 0 so NULL gives ''
TDateTime days since 1899-12-30; 1900-01-01 is a real date, only 0 is the sentinel
FormatDateTime('yyyymmdd') zero-padded

ops.does: Insert the cleaned row with the note looked up by IntToStr(id)
implicit: Values[...] of a missing key is '' (stored as '' text, not NULL)
notes were loaded before CUSTOMER is read
